title: Process, spend money and nothing is outputed
body:
### What version of Codex is running?

0.1.2504251709

### Which model were you using?

o4-mini

### What platform is your computer?

Linux 5.15.167.4-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64 unknown

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

- Write a well structured and big prompt
- Send
- Wait for more than 300s

### What is the expected behavior?

EExpect to process, read files, undestand the change to be done, apply patch and explain what was done.

### What do you see instead?

I see the explanation of what was done, but no changes were applied to my code.

### Additional information

_No response_
